plugins.name: angel-protocol
plugins.description: Welfare-check escalation for a solo operator: watches ambient proof-of-life signals (movement, wearable sync, chat activity) and walks a staged cascade from a soft chat nudge to direct SMS to emergency-contact notification when the principal goes quiet. Pluggable SMS providers (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, AWS SNS), dry-run mode, and pause controls.

plugins.name: bfl
plugins.description: Quantified-self food and training pipeline: ingests meal photos and captions via vision extraction into the chassis Postgres, enriches entries against USDA FoodData Central, and reconciles daily logs on a heartbeat. Ships its DB migration, a chat backfill trigger, and model benchmarking tooling.

plugins.name: dating
plugins.description: Dating-app automation for a sandboxed subagent: emulator-driven swipe sessions, CLIP photo scoring against installer-tuned prompts, reverse-image catfish screening, conversation state and directives in Postgres, and hard safety rails (photo verification, scheduling blocks, pause flags, welfare-check integration). Regional gating ships disabled with an empty country list.

plugins.name: loom-vision
plugins.description: Process a Loom share URL into multimodal context: downloaded video, sampled frames, and the auto-generated transcript converted to WebVTT + plaintext.

plugins.name: remarkable
plugins.description: reMarkable tablet integration over the cloud API (ddvk rmapi): deliver briefings and documents OTA, read and write a shared collab notebook page by page, ingest full notebooks to searchable text, plus a health heartbeat that alerts when sync auth breaks.

plugins.name: restaurant-booking
plugins.description: Book a restaurant table from a chat message: parses natural-language intent, drives TheFork via Playwright, soft-confirms with the installer through a Discord reaction before submitting, and can create the matching Google Calendar event. Strongest coverage where TheFork is strong (Lisbon and wider Europe).

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.description: Privacy-enforced WhatsApp group reading via wacli: a wrapper that only permits reads of explicitly allowlisted group JIDs, blocks every DM and send path, and supports digest and lead-scan workflows without touching private conversations.
